lines.text: Zendesk claims its AI Agents can achieve up to 80% automation. It also includes built-in QA scoring for 100% of AI interactions.
Zendesk Contact Center embeds AI across voice and digital in a unified system.
Zendesk makes it easy to start: a 14-day free trial with no credit card, and up to 2 years free for qualified startups.
lines.reason: the reader: characterization that these features make it easy to start

lines.text: Zendesk claims scale: more than 80,000 companies choose it for AI service, and 22,000+ service teams trust Zendesk AI.
Freshdesk publishes clear per-agent prices, billed annually: Growth $19, Pro $55, Enterprise $89.

The Freddy AI Agent is included on all three plans, with 500 complimentary AI sessions. Freddy AI Copilot is an add-on for Pro and Enterprise. Freddy AI Insights on Enterprise runs root cause analysis for leaders.

Freshdesk is built for growing service teams, typically businesses of 50 to 500 employees. It is described as a good fit for small and midsize businesses, with a simple interface that doesn't require consultants or third-party support.
Freshdesk turns queries from email, portal, chat, phone and social into trackable tickets in one Command Center.
Pro and above add multiple SLA policies for different customers, products or priorities, plus custom dashboards. Built-in dashboards and report templates come on every plan.
Proof point: Thomas Cook cut unresolved tickets by 37% while total tickets handled rose 55%.

Freshdesk is extensible. It offers API endpoints, app development documentation, and Technology Partners who build apps and integrations. It integrates with Google Workspace, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Shopify and Mailchimp.
How big is your support team and company? Freshdesk is aimed at businesses of about 50 to 500 employees.
Do you have in-house admins or consultants to set up and run your helpdesk, or do you want a simple interface that doesn't need them?
lines.reason: it and its facts disagree on a negation

lines.text: Which tools must your helpdesk connect to? Can we check them against our 1,200 integrations and API?
Do you need unified voice and digital AI in one system? That is where Zendesk Contact Center is positioned.
Do you need multiple SLA policies or custom dashboards? Those start at our Pro plan.
Would you want to try AI on your own tickets first? Freddy AI Agent comes with 500 complimentary sessions on every plan.

Its marketplace lists 1,800+ and ours covers 1,200 common business apps, including Slack, Teams, Shopify and Google Workspace. We also have open API endpoints and app development docs. Let's check that the specific tools you use are covered.
That's a real recognition for them. Freshdesk is built for teams of roughly 50 to 500 employees, with an interface that doesn't need consultants. The question is which fits your team.
That is their 'up to' claim. With Freshdesk, the Freddy AI Agent is on every plan with 500 complimentary AI sessions, so you can test it on your own tickets.
lines.objection: Zendesk says its AI can automate up to 80%.

lines.text: That's a fair point in their favour. On our side, per-agent pricing is published: $19, $55 and $89, billed annually. You can judge cost against the features you need.
